# ruststream-gcp-pubsub

> `ruststream-gcp-pubsub` is the Google Cloud Pub/Sub broker crate for RustStream, a Rust framework for services that subscribe to message brokers and publish to them. It runs over the official `google-cloud-pubsub` client: a handler reads a subscription through one streaming pull, Pub/Sub acknowledges each message on its own, and an ordering key is the framework's partition key.

A subscription is the descriptor `GooglePubSub`, which names a subscription and carries every setting it takes: topology created at startup, flow control, lease extension, the lease budget and the batch wait; a bare `#[subscriber("orders-workers")]` reads an existing subscription with every default. A retry cap and a dead-letter topic named at the mount site become the subscription's own dead-letter policy. A service imports `ruststream_gcp_pubsub::prelude::*`, which offers `PubSubPublish` as `Publish`; the ordering key of one publish is its per-message setting. `PubSubBroker::emulator` points the service at a local emulator.

This site holds the guides, one page per component and the architecture of the crate; the API reference is on docs.rs, and the framework itself is documented on the RustStream site.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/): building a Pub/Sub service with the crate, from a first subscriber to production
- [Getting started](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/guides/getting-started/): install the crate, run a first subscriber against the emulator and test it
- [Topics and subscriptions](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/guides/topics-and-subscriptions/): fan-out, replicas sharing a subscription, topology the service or operations own
- [Publishing and replies](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/guides/publishing/): replies whose type names the topic, `Out` slots and a publish at startup
- [Acknowledgement and retries](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/guides/retries/): ack, retry, `retry_after` and drop on Pub/Sub, the dead-letter policy and exactly-once
- [Flow control and leases](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/guides/flow-control/): `max_outstanding`, `ack_extension` and `max_lease`
- [Ordering keys](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/guides/ordering/): ordered subscriptions, keyed lanes and the key on what a service publishes
- [Batch processing](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/guides/batches/): a slice handler, the batch size and wait, settling each message
- [Running in production](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/guides/production/): credentials, a regional endpoint, operations-owned topology and IAM roles
- [Testing a Pub/Sub service](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/guides/testing/): one test body in process and against the emulator

## Components

- [Components](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/): the parts of the crate a Pub/Sub service uses, one page each
- [PubSubBroker](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/broker/): the broker type, its project and its lazy connection
- [emulator](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/broker/emulator/): a local Pub/Sub emulator at a `host:port` or a URL, with anonymous credentials
- [credentials](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/broker/credentials/): a `google-cloud-auth` credentials value in place of Application Default Credentials
- [endpoint](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/broker/endpoint/): another Pub/Sub endpoint, such as a locational one that keeps every request in one region
- [Startup](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/broker/startup/): the clients built at connect, then each subscription's topology and streaming pull
- [Shutdown](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/broker/shutdown/): the flush of every publisher, and `PubSubError::NotConnected` for a publisher used afterwards
- [Errors](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/broker/errors/): `PubSubError`, the one error type of the crate
- [Prelude](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/broker/prelude/): `ruststream_gcp_pubsub::prelude`, the one glob a Pub/Sub service imports
- [Subscriptions](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/subscriptions/): a subscription name in `#[subscriber]` and the descriptor that carries every other setting
- [GooglePubSub](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/subscriptions/google-pubsub/): one subscription by short id or full resource name, with its settings
- [name](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/subscriptions/name/): `#[subscriber(GooglePubSub)]` with the subscription named at the mount site
- [create_with_topic](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/subscriptions/create-with-topic/): the subscription and its topic created at startup, with message ordering on
- [max_outstanding](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/subscriptions/max-outstanding/): the cap on deliveries unsettled at once
- [ack_extension](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/subscriptions/ack-extension/): how far each background extension of a lease reaches
- [max_lease](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/subscriptions/max-lease/): how long one unsettled delivery stays leased, and the budget of `retry_after`
- [Batches](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/subscriptions/batches/): slice handlers over batches assembled on the client, with `batch(n)` and `batch_wait`
- [Acknowledgement](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/settlement/): what `ack`, `retry` and `drop` do on Pub/Sub, exactly-once subscriptions included
- [retry_after](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/settlement/retry-after/): a delivery held under its lease for the delay, then nacked
- [Dead letters](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/settlement/dead-letters/): `max_attempts` and `dead_letter` as the subscription's own dead-letter policy
- [Attempts](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/settlement/attempts/): the attempt number in the `pubsub-delivery-attempt` header
- [PubSubPublish](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/publishing/): the publish policy, `Publish` in the prelude
- [Headers](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/publishing/headers/): headers as Pub/Sub attributes, with no envelope
- [Ordering](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/publishing/ordering/): messages that share an ordering key, delivered in the order they were published
- [ordering_key](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/publishing/ordering/ordering-key/): the ordering key of one publish, on the publish builder
- [Policy](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/publishing/ordering/policy/): `Publish::default().ordering_key(..)`, one key for a whole mount site
- [PARTITION_KEY_HEADER](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/publishing/ordering/partition-key/): the `partition-key` header, the portable spelling of the ordering key
- [Transform](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/publishing/ordering/transform/): a reply transform that sets the ordering key per delivery
- [Bindings](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/asyncapi/): the `googlepubsub` bindings of the AsyncAPI document behind the `asyncapi` feature
- [Server](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/asyncapi/server/): the host and port clients dial, under the protocol `googlepubsub`
- [Messages](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/asyncapi/messages/): the ordering key a publish policy fixed, in the message binding
- [Channels](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/asyncapi/channels/): a subscription as a channel received on, and a topic as one sent to
- [Testing](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/testing/): `TestApp::start` with `PubSubBroker` in process behind the `testing` feature
- [Live](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/components/testing/live/): `TestApp::start_live`, the same test body against the emulator

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/): how Pub/Sub works, where the crate sits between Pub/Sub and the RustStream runtime, and what that costs
- [Topics](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/pubsub/): a topic hands every message to each attached subscription, whose subscribers share it
- [Leases](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/pubsub/leases/): the streaming pull's lease on each message, its extension and flow control
- [Ordered delivery](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/pubsub/ordering/): messages sharing an ordering key, published in one region, delivered in order
- [Redelivery](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/pubsub/redelivery/): a nack or an expired deadline, and the dead-letter policy that ends redelivery
- [Design](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/design/): a streaming pull per subscription and a publisher per topic, between the runtime and the client
- [Lifecycle](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/lifecycle/): `new`, `connect`, each subscription opened at startup, and the flush at shutdown
- [Path](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/path/): one message from the streaming pull through the handler and the reply to its ack
- [Settlement](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/settlement/): what `ack`, `retry`, `retry_after` and `drop` become on Pub/Sub
- [Benchmarks](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/benchmarks/): what the crate costs over the raw `google-cloud-pubsub` client, and the cost of its own code
- [Benchmarks: Numbers](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/benchmarks/numbers/): what each published number measures, and what it does not allow you to conclude
- [Benchmarks: Methodology](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-gcp-pubsub/latest/architecture/benchmarks/methodology/): the three loops, the run against the emulator, the broker-bound arithmetic and the code count
